name: Support Ticket Triage
description: Categorises and prioritises incoming support tickets, drafts response templates for common issues, and flags complex cases for human review before responses are sent.

input_parameters.label: Ticket Batch
input_parameters.placeholder: Paste the ticket batch. For each ticket include: ticket ID, subject, customer type, and message content.

input_parameters.label: Product / Service Context
input_parameters.placeholder: Brief description of your product or service

input_parameters.label: Response SLA Targets
input_parameters.placeholder: e.g., P1: 1 hour, P2: 4 hours, P3: 24 hours

steps.label: Categorise and Prioritise Tickets
steps.description: ANTON categorises tickets by type and priority, flags complexity, and identifies patterns.

config.promptTemplate:
Triage the following support tickets for {{product_context}}.

SLA targets: {{sla_targets}}

Tickets:
{{ticket_batch}}

For each ticket produce:
- Priority (P1 Critical / P2 High / P3 Standard / P4 Low)
- Category (Bug, Feature Request, How-to Question, Billing, Complaint, Data Issue, Other)
- Complexity (Simple: standard response / Complex: needs investigation / Escalate: requires specialist)
- Suggested owner type (Front-line / Technical / Management)
- Brief note on reasoning

Also identify any patterns across the batch (multiple tickets with the same issue, unusual volume in a category).

steps.label: Draft Response Templates
steps.description: ANTON drafts response templates for Simple and P2/P3 tickets.

config.promptTemplate:
Based on the ticket triage:
{{step-0.output}}

Draft response templates for all Simple tickets and P2/P3 tickets. For each response:
- Address the customer's actual question or complaint
- Be professional, empathetic, and helpful
- Include specific next steps or resolution information
- Flag any responses that require information you do not have (mark as [NEEDS INFO: ...])

Do NOT draft responses for Complex or Escalate tickets — mark these as [REQUIRES HUMAN RESPONSE].

steps.label: Support Lead Review
steps.description: Review drafted responses and approve, edit, or redirect complex tickets.

config.checkpointMessage: Review the triage and drafted responses. Approve responses for sending, edit where needed, and decide how to handle escalated tickets.

inputFields.label: Response approvals and edits
inputFields.placeholder:
For each ticket: [Ticket ID] — Approve / Edit (paste correction) / Reassign to [person/team]

For escalations: [Ticket ID] — Assign to [specialist] / Will handle personally

inputFields.label: Action on any patterns identified
inputFields.placeholder: If ANTON identified ticket patterns, describe any systemic actions you want to take...
